scope: deployment hardening only: no training, no architecture/tokenizer/vocabulary/annotation change, no new compression variant, no new data
architecture: compression-v3: pretrained BamiBERT-derived 4x768 (layers 2,5,8,11), FFN 2048 (combined criterion), 34 position rows, vocabulary B-rank-8000 (8,338 tokens), max_length 32, ONNX INT8 (dynamic, QInt8 weights)

seed_selection.rule: seed 1, the seed fixed in advance as the export/deployment seed in distillation-v2, compression-v1, compression-v3 and compression-v4
seed_selection.why_not_held_out_metrics: experiments/compression-v3/protocol.json declares 'selection: none on held-out data; test and probe-v1 are evaluation only'. The frozen validation split (110 notes) is part of the 723-note training set (every seed fits it at F1 1.000), so no clean held-out selection set exists. Picking the seed with the best test or probe numbers would select on the test/probe sets and bias every later number reported for the deployed model.
seed_selection.sanity_check_only: per-seed held-out results are reported for transparency and checked only for a pathological regression (a seed far outside the other two on test joint or a whole probe pattern); they do not rank seeds

golden_suite_source: approved, human-labelled annotation-v1 records outside test and probe-v1 (train/validation splits; skipped records from labels.jsonl for the pipeline-level case). Expected outputs are the PyTorch reference predictions of the deployed checkpoint, with the human label stored alongside for information; the suite checks runtime correctness, not model quality.
thresholds: none; confidences are reported, abstention policy is left to a later calibration phase
acceptance_gate: artifact reproducible from the source checkpoint (bitwise or output-identical)
bundle tokenizer encodes identically to the training tokenizer
golden suite: PyTorch vs ONNX FP32 vs ONNX INT8 prediction parity reported; runtime output equals the PyTorch reference decode for FP32
offsets map back to the caller's original string
runtime reads only the bundle directory
